fields.Name: T270 - Lists Browse View Mode Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the three distinct render branches (table/card/hierarchy) of lists-browse-resource driven by mj-view-toggle, including the category-grouped hierarchy tree — a Lists-specific multi-layout switch.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and select the Lists application; the default 'Lists' (Browse) section opens. In the toolbar there is a view toggle offering table, card, and hierarchy layouts. Switch between at least two of these modes. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Success is that toggling the view mode visibly changes how the lists are laid out — e.g. a row/column table with Name/Entity/Items/Owner columns vs. a grid of cards vs. a folder-grouped hierarchy tree. (If the user has no lists, the 'No Lists Yet' empty state is a valid render.)

judgeValidationCriteria: The Lists browse section renders lists (in table, card, or hierarchy form) OR a valid 'No Lists Yet' empty state
Activating a different view-toggle option changes the layout — the table columns, card grid, and hierarchy folder tree are visually distinct from one another
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
